description: A task to help students understand the concept of left and right.

engage.speech_start: Hello friends! Today we have a super fun mission. We are going to learn all about our left and right sides. Are you ready? Let's go!
engage.speech_end: Do you remember which hand is your left hand? Raise it up high!
engage.description: Connect with prior knowledge. Show video if needed. Not compulsory.

explore.speech_start: Time to move around! Let's explore together.
explore.description: Students observe objects and identify directions.
explore.activity_description: Students raise their left hand and right hand and show to the teacher. (Kinesthetic activity with teacher guidance)
explore.speech_end: Awesome exploring! Let's head back to our lesson.

explain.speech_start: Look at your hands! The hand that makes an 'L' shape is your left hand. The other one is your right hand!
explain.speech_end: Now you know what left and right means. You're so smart!
explain.description: Robot explains the concept using examples.

elaborate.speech_start: Hmm, let's look at this one closer. Can you help me find the right answer?
elaborate.speech_end: Excellent! You are learning so fast!
elaborate.task_description: Which image shows the left hand?

evaluate.speech_start: Alright, it's time to show what you know! Look carefully at the screen.
